landing.heroLead: Your land, on the map and in the register.
landing.whatBody: One public register for every plot in Mogadishu: surveyed on the map, checked by the land office, published for objections, then registered with a unique number you can rely on.

register.title: Register your land
register.body: Apply online or at the district office. A surveyor draws your plot and you get a Parcel Unique Number (PUN).

pay.title: Pay property tax
pay.body: See your bill and pay by EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab, bank or cash, with a receipt every time.

verify.title: Check before you buy
verify.body: Every registered plot is on public notice first, and every certificate carries a QR code anyone can verify.

owner.label: Property owners
owner.text: Your plot gets a boundary, a number and a record of its owners — so nobody can quietly sell what is yours.

buyer.label: Buyers
buyer.text: Before you pay, look the plot up, check who owns it and whether anyone has objected or a dispute is open.

bank.label: Banks
bank.text: A verified title with a known boundary is something you can lend against. Liens and transfers are recorded on the same register.

staff.label: District staff
staff.text: Applications, surveys, verification and registration in one workspace, with every decision recorded and checked by a second person.

landing.howBody: Seven steps, each recorded. You can follow your application at any time with its number.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Owners, documents and a pin on the map — online, at the office or with a field officer.

fee.title: Application fee
fee.body: Paid by mobile money or at the cashier, or waived by finance with a recorded reason.

survey.title: Survey
survey.body: A surveyor measures the plot on site and draws its boundary; overlaps with neighbours are caught here.

verify.title: Verification
verify.body: A land officer checks documents, identities and the survey.

notice.title: Public notice
notice.body: The plot is published so anyone with a claim can object before it is registered.

register.title: Registration
register.body: The registrar approves and the plot gets its PUN and account number.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.body: Collect your title certificate and property ID card, each with a QR check.

dashboard.view: Open the Dashboard and use the AI assistant.

map.view: Open the Map and see parcel boundaries.
map.edit_geometry: Fix a survey's boundary during the GIS overlap review.

applications.view: See land that is waiting for registration through an application.
applications.create: Add land found in the field (Add land) and start its registration.
applications.update: Work land waiting for registration: correct its details, re-bill its fee, ask for a site check, move it on.
applications.approve: Verify land waiting for registration so it can be registered.
applications.capture_location: Set or move a house's GPS pin, and fix its location in a data correction.

parcels.view: Open Parcels and see the Partial registration tab (land not registered yet) in your districts.
parcels.registered: See the Registered tab in Parcels: land on the official register.
parcels.update: Edit a parcel's office details, send a surveyor to check it exists, and request changes (boundary, subdivide, change of use).
parcels.approve: Register land (gives the PUN and raises its bills), and decide parcel changes and leases.
parcels.delete_registered: Delete registered land from the register. Land with money paid can never be deleted.
parcels.lock: Lock and unlock a parcel, e.g. for a court case, so nothing on it can change.
parcels.yet_to_register: Open Yet to register: neighbourhoods still to register, and zones given to surveyors.

owners.view: Open Owners and see the Partial owners; check for duplicates.
owners.registered: See the Registered tab in Owners.
owners.update: Edit an owner's details and photo.
owners.approve: Move an owner to the register.
owners.delete_registered: Delete a registered owner (only one who holds no land).

surveys.view: Open Surveys and the zones, and see survey tasks.
surveys.create: Work as a surveyor: add land in a zone, ask for site checks, be given survey tasks.
surveys.update: Do your own survey tasks and site checks, and record what you found on site.

valuation.view: Open Valuation (grades, rates, assessments) and see a parcel's tax calculation.

valuation.update: Set house types (grades) and their price, neighbourhood rates, fees, and a parcel's buildings.

billing.create: Start, refresh, submit and cancel billing runs.
billing.update: Request payment plans and apply late penalties.
billing.approve: Approve billing runs and generate their invoices; decide payment plans.

invoices.view: Open Invoices and see what parcels owe.

invoices.cancel: Cancel an invoice that has no payments.

payments.view: Open Payments and see the money received.

cashier.view: Open Cashier and its To collect list.
cashier.update: Close a cashier shift with a cash count.

reconciliation.view: Open Collections: what cashiers collected, duplicates and daily reconciliation.

reconciliation.update: Verify or dispute payments, add evidence, and prepare a day's reconciliation.
reconciliation.approve: Approve or reject a day's reconciliation.

transfers.view: Open Transfers and a parcel's Legal card.
transfers.create: Start, edit and submit transfers of ownership.

disputes.create: Open disputes, register liens and add court orders.
disputes.approve: Close disputes, release liens, lift court orders and resolve objections.

permits.create: Apply for a building permit for a parcel.

documents.view: See the map outlines printed on certificates.

certificates.view: Open Certificates and see issued certificates and ID cards.
certificates.approve: Issue certificates and ID cards, and decide reprints.
certificates.print: Print certificates and ID cards, and set owners' photos for cards.
certificates.cancel: Cancel a certificate or ID card.
certificates.reprint: Ask for a certificate or ID card to be reprinted or reissued.

messages.view: Open Messages: SMS and WhatsApp sent to owners.

messages.cancel: Stop a message from being sent.

reports.view: Open Reports and the figures on the Dashboard.
reports.export: Download reports as PDF or Excel.
reports.assistant: Use the AI finance helper on Reports.

locations.view: Open Locations: districts, sections, sectors, neighbourhoods and streets.
locations.update: Edit locations and draw their boundaries.

settings.update: Change settings, fee amounts, payment providers, house types and cash desks.

audit.view: Open the Audit log and Login history.

users.view: Open Users and see staff accounts.
users.create: Add staff accounts and send invitations.
users.update: Edit staff accounts: name, roles, districts and cash desk.
users.reset_password: Set a new password or send a reset link.

roles.update: Change a role's permissions and move its users.

valuation.gradesHelp: Yearly amount per building unit of each grade.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Figures for the districts you can see. Every report can be downloaded as PDF or Excel.

notes.revenue: Money received, by the month it was received, split by what it paid for. Unallocated credit is money not yet matched to a bill.
notes.arrears: Open balances today, by how long they are past the due date. Dates don't apply.
notes.collection: Bills issued in the period and how much of them has been paid or credited.
notes.registrations: Applications submitted and parcels registered per month. Median days runs from submission to registration.
notes.cashiers: Shifts opened in the period, what each cashier took, and cash differences at close.
notes.income: From the ledger. Income is what was billed and earned; money in is what reached cash, mobile money, card or bank; money out is refunds and reversals.
notes.billing: Bills issued in the period by month, district and fee type, with what has been paid and what is still owed.
notes.invoices: Every bill issued in the period. Paid includes credits.
notes.payments: Every payment received in the period, with the bills it paid, the cashier and the point of sale.
notes.certificates: Certificates and ID cards issued in the period.
notes.parcels: Parcels as they are today. Partial means land not yet registered (draft, surveyed or verified, often with a provisional shape).
notes.owners: Current owners, co-owners and heirs, one row per owner and parcel. Dates don't apply.
notes.locations: Districts, sections, sectors and neighbourhoods with the parcels in each and whether a boundary is drawn. Dates don't apply.
notes.paymentTypes: For each revenue category (fee type), how much came in by Cash, EVC Plus, eDahab, ZAAD, Bank transfer, Visa / Mastercard and Other, with the grand total. Click a category or an amount to see those payments.
notes.collections: Total collections = Cash + EVC Plus + eDahab + ZAAD + Bank transfer (+ Visa / Mastercard and Other), per day, per week (Monday to Sunday) or per month. By default only payments a finance officer verified count.
notes.collectionsCashier: What each cashier collected by way of paying, how much is not yet verified, how many of their days are reconciled, and the shortages and excess found.
notes.shortages: Each cashier day reconciled in the period: recorded against actually received, the difference per way of paying (± column), shortage = recorded − received, excess = received − recorded, and who prepared and approved it.
notes.unreconciled: Payments not yet in an approved cashier reconciliation: pending, verified or disputed, oldest first.
